title: Curate plan-generated public procurement research CLI
reason: The plan-driven generator produced a command scaffold. This patch records the curated read-only USAspending, Grants.gov, and SAM.gov command behavior needed for issue #1193.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover request construction, award rollups, agency matching, Grants.gov payloads, and SAM.gov missing-key setup behavior. Live smoke tests cover USAspending vendor/agency/awards, Grants.gov search, keyless source checks, and SAM.gov dry-run/missing-key behavior.
